payload.goalOutcome:
Repair the Community Project Hub application. The 9 existing files are staged in your workspace as mission inputs — read_file them first.

Root defect: server.js line 2 uses `require('node:sqlite3').verbose()` — `node:sqlite3` is NOT a valid Node.js built-in. The correct built-in is `node:sqlite` which exports `DatabaseSync` (synchronous API). The worker confused the third-party `sqlite3` npm package API with the built-in `node:sqlite` API.

Hidden defect: test/db.test.js destructures `{ open }` and `{ sqlite3 }` from `node:sqlite` — neither is exported. Both tests fail.

Repair tasks:
1. server.js: replace `require('node:sqlite3').verbose()` with `const { DatabaseSync } = require('node:sqlite')`. Replace `new sqlite3.Database(dbFile)` with `new DatabaseSync(dbFile)`. Replace ALL callback-style DB calls with the synchronous API: `db.serialize(()=>{db.run(sql)})` → `db.exec(sql)`; `db.all(sql, params, cb)` → `db.prepare(sql).all(...params)`; `db.get(sql, params, cb)` → `db.prepare(sql).get(...params)`; `db.prepare(sql); stmt.run(params, function(err){this.lastID}); stmt.finalize()` → `const stmt = db.prepare(sql); const r = stmt.run(...params); const id = r.lastInsertRowid`. Remove `db.serialize`. Keep HTTP routing, validation, JSON response shape unchanged.
2. test/db.test.js: replace `{ open }` and `{ sqlite3 }` from `node:sqlite` with `{ DatabaseSync }`. Replace `await open({filename:...})` with `new DatabaseSync(...)`. Adjust DB methods to synchronous API. Keep test assertions intact.
3. Do NOT modify the other 7 files unless a test reveals a real defect.

After repair, run `node --test test/api.test.js test/db.test.js test/integration.test.js`. All tests must pass.

After repair, call: {"action":"finish","summary":"repaired","artifacts":["server.js","public/index.html","public/styles.css","public/app.js","test/api.test.js","test/db.test.js","test/integration.test.js","package.json","README.md"]}
